summary: ORIENT's 24 TV episodes adapt manga chapters 1-115 densely and in order, in one continuous chapter space (1-156 / 22 vols) that survives the Weekly-Shonen-Magazine-to-Bessatsu move. MU's coverage string is HALF right: its first-cour segment 'Vol 6, Chap 46 (S1P1)' is CONFIRMED for ep 12 (which then trails a 5-page teaser of ch 47 that ep 13 restages and completes — a sliver, not a position, A10/A44), but its second-cour segment 'Vol 13, Chap 113 (S1P2)' is UNDERSTATED and internally inconsistent: ch 113 is the LAST chapter of volume 12 and the last chapter of the WSM run, while volume 13 (Kodansha 初出: 別マガ 2021年3-6月号) is ch 114-117. Episode 24 reaches ch 115 「誓い」 — the official synopsis names both the ch-114 honours ceremony (Kojiro and his father Jisai's mystery) and the bushi's 「誓い」, and the chapter pages' casts for 114/115 (Kuroko Usami, Aoshi Sanada, Shunrai Yamamoto, the Tanegashima, the full Obsidian Eight) are the finale's cast and are absent from ch 113. So the pin is repaired 113 → 115, volume 13 unchanged, and the post-series resume is ch 116 with ch 116-156 (the Houjo arc onward, through vol 22) never adapted. This entry holds ZERO episode rows (flag #438), so the row -> title -> air-date table for all 24 episodes is delivered in structure.notes from three agreeing sources; flag #769 resolves as no edition split — MU's latest_chapter 121 is its scanlation release ceiling.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 43-46 (+ ch 47 pp. 1-5 as a trailing teaser, not the END — see note)
anchors.note: First cour's finale. orient.fandom's page-partitioned field gives ep 12 = ch 43, 44, 45, 46, 47 (pp. 1-5) and ep 13 = ch 47 (pp. 2-4, 6-18), 48-52; MU's string independently splits the cours at the same seam (P1 end 'Vol 6, Chap 46' / P2 start 'Vol 6, Chap 47'). END = 46 (A4): the ch-47 tail is 5 pages of an 18-page chapter, three of which (pp. 2-4) are re-staged in ep 13 — a teaser at exactly A10's <=5-page sliver threshold, so it is not the position; the official ep-12 synopsis likewise stops at 「鐘巻武士団が進む先は……」, before Shiryu Castle (ch 47 紫龍城). START = 43 (ep 11 ends cleanly on ch 42). Volume from Kodansha's official 目次 for vol 6 = 第43話-第52話. MU's S1P1 segment is CONFIRMED and REDUNDANT (G56).

Series finale (2nd cour ep 12). orient.fandom gives ep 24 = ch 111 (pp. 17-18), 112, 113, 114, 115 — ep 23 ended at ch 111 p. 16, so the 2-page lead-in is a <=5-page sliver and START = 112 (A10). END = 115 (A4) 「誓い」, the last chapter of the Awaji Island Recapture Operation arc: the official orient-anime.jp synopsis for 第24話 names the ch-114 material (「小次郎は父・自斎の謎を解き明かすことができるのか」 = the 軍功 honours ceremony where Kojiro shows Jisai's Uesugi-sealed scroll to Tatsuomi; ch 114's cast list carries Jisai in flashback) AND the ch-115 beat (「淡路島奪還作戦に関わったすべての武士たちが願った『誓い』とは」 = Michiru's last day and her death, closing on Katsumi taken by the Obsidian Eight — ch 115's cast is the only one that holds Kuroko Usami, Aoshi Sanada, Shunrai Yamamoto, Mamori/Shige Tanegashima and all eight black dogs). Volume 13 = ch 114-117 per Kodansha's official 初出 (別マガ 2021年3月号〜6月号) and per Magazine Pocket's 【第115話】誓い (2021-03-09 = 別マガ 2021年4月号). Ch 116 「強くならなきゃ」 opens the Houjo arc and is NOT in the episode.

continue_points.note: Resume at ch 47 「紫龍城」. Ep 12 closes on a 5-page teaser of ch 47 and ep 13 opens by re-staging pp. 2-4 and then adapting pp. 6-18 — so parity with the next episode's start (C2) and the mid-chapter straddle (C1) give the same value; a reader who starts at ch 47 loses nothing and re-reads only the pages ep 13 re-shows. Nothing between ch 1 and 46 is skipped.

Post-series resume (C5 = furthest first-time coverage + 1, coverage per A4). The anime adapts ch 1-115 with no gap; ch 116 「強くならなきゃ」 - 156 (the Houjo arc through the finale, i.e. the rest of vol 13 and vols 14-22) is NEVER adapted, and neither is the vol-13 bonus chapter 115.5 「つぐみとみちるのワクワク女子会」. Start at ch 116, not at vol 14 as the fan 'where to continue' pages say.

annotations.note: Trailing 5-page teaser of ch 47 (the bands gathering at Harima / Shiryu Castle) closes the cour; pp. 2-4 are re-staged and pp. 6-18 adapted in ep 13. Sliver at the A10 threshold — annotated, never the END.

orient.fandom's 'Differences from the manga' for ep 12: the anime ADDS scenes introducing Tatsuomi Uesugi, Kanetatsu Naoe, Masaki Amakasu, the Amako and Shimazu bands and Kijinosuke Noguchi ahead of their manga entrances — expansion inside a canon episode, not a second source.
Two-page carry-over of ep 23's cliffhanger (ch 111 ends at p. 18); excluded from START by A10's <=5-page sliver rule.

repairs.why: The stored anchor is MangaUpdates' unverified coverage pin ('Vol 13, Chap 113 (S1P2)') and it is BOTH understated and internally inconsistent (G37): ch 113 is the LAST chapter of volume 12 and the last chapter of the Weekly Shonen Magazine run (WSM 2021 #6), while volume 13 — the volume MU itself names — is ch 114-117 per Kodansha's official 初出 (別冊少年マガジン 2021年3月号〜6月号), a boundary MU's own release records repeat (c 116/117 tagged v13). Ep 24 adapts through ch 115: the official synopsis names the ch-114 honours ceremony and Jisai thread and the ch-115 「誓い」, and orient.fandom's page-level field reads 111 (pp. 17-18), 112-115. What MU counted: the end of the WSM serialization / the end of vol 12 — two chapters short of the finale's true end. Volume 13 stands; the anchor also gains START 112.

SLOT / DATE CHECKS (G53/G54): cour 1 = TV Tokyo Thu 00:00 (Wed late night) — eps 1-10 are ten consecutive Thursdays; ep 11 was PREEMPTED on 2022-03-17 by earthquake news (2022 Fukushima quake) and aired back-to-back with ep 12 on 2022-03-24 as an hour block (syobocal carries both the cancelled 03-17 airing and a "#11～#12" 03-24 block; ja-WP and en-WP both print 3月24日 for eps 11 AND 12; ANN's headline "rescheduled for March 23" is the same airing named by its Wednesday-night clock). Cour 2 = TV Tokyo Tue 01:30 (Mon late night) — twelve consecutive Tuesdays 07-12 … 09-27. No out-of-order broadcast; no date deviates from its slot.

CHAPTER SPACE (flag #769 — MU latest_chapter 121 vs AniList 156): there is ONE continuous chapter numbering, 1-156 in 22 volumes, and no edition split. ORIENT ran in Weekly Shonen Magazine 2018 #28 - 2021 #6 and then MOVED to Bessatsu Shonen Magazine 2021年3月号 - 2024年11月号; the numbering did NOT restart at the move — ch 113 is the last WSM chapter (WSM 2021 #6, 2021-01-06) and ch 114 the first Bessatsu chapter (別マガ 2021年3月号), which Kodansha's own 初出 lines prove volume by volume: vol 12 初出 = 『週刊少年マガジン』2020年第45号〜第48号、第50号〜2021年第1号、第4・5合併号、第6号 (10 chapters = 104-113); vol 13 初出 = 『別冊少年マガジン』2021年3月号〜6月号 (4 chapters = 114-117); vol 14 初出 = 『別冊少年マガジン』2021年7月号〜10月号 (118-121). ja-WP's infobox states 全156話 / 全22巻 and MangaDex's series record gives lastChapter 156 / lastVolume 22 — AniList's 156 IS our space; no conversion is needed for either anchor. MU's latest_chapter 121 is the ceiling of MU's RELEASE records (Sense-Scans etc.; the newest is 2023-03-12 v14 c120) — a release-record artifact, not an edition and not a chapter count (the standing MU trap). Magazine Pocket splits the 47-page ch 115 into digital units 【第115話(1)】/【第115話(2)】 — a storefront re-cut that keeps the serialization number 第115話, not a renumber.

VOLUME BOUNDARIES touched by these anchors (0 stored; official 目次/初出 where available): vol 5 = ch 33-42 (Kodansha 目次), vol 6 = ch 43-52 (Kodansha 目次: 第43話 黒の会合 … 第52話 三すくみ) + omake 52.5, vol 11 = …-103, vol 12 = ch 104-113, vol 13 = ch 114-117 + omake 115.5 (つぐみとみちるのワクワク女子会), vol 14 = ch 118-121. MU's own release records agree (c 116/117 tagged v13; c 118/120 tagged v14).

EPISODE-TITLE TRAP: this anime borrows chapter titles one to two chapters BEHIND the episode's own coverage — ep 11 「刀に宿るもの」 = ch 41's title, ep 12 「この道の先に」 = ch 42's title (Kodansha vol 5 目次), while ep 11 adapts 40-42 and ep 12 adapts 43-46. So the ep 24 / ch 115 title identity 「誓い」 is NOT by itself proof of coverage; the ep-24 verdict rests on the official synopsis's CONTENT (Kojiro/Jisai's mystery = ch 114's ceremony and Jisai flashback; the bushi's 「誓い」 = ch 115) plus the chapter pages' cast lists.

COVERAGE SHAPE: the run is a dense, gapless, page-partitioned adaptation of ch 1-115 in order (eps 1-12 = ch 1-46/47, eps 13-24 = ch 47-115) with exactly one out-of-order fragment — ep 16 grafts ch 101 pp. 13-15 as a flash-forward, and ep 22 adapts ch 101 in full. No filler episode, no recap; all 24 rows are canon adaptations when they are minted. Nothing between ch 1 and 115 is skipped, so the post-series continue is a clean coverage+1.

flags_for_sean: SPLIT EVIDENCE on ep 24 (resolved, but name it): two fan aggregators say the anime ends at ch 113 — MU's pin itself, and wheredoestheanimeleaveoff.com ('you can pick up the manga at Chapter 114. The anime adapts all of Volume 12'), which is plausibly downstream of MU. Both are volume-level roundings and both contradict the OFFICIAL ep-24 synopsis, which names the ch-114 ceremony/Jisai thread and the ch-115 「誓い」; a third content farm (newstisiki) rounds the other way ('3期は原作14巻から', i.e. past 117) while the same search's other page says the 2nd cour covered '原作6巻〜13巻の途中まで'. I took the primary (official synopsis + page-partitioned wiki + Kodansha volume 初出) over the aggregators. URL: https://wheredoestheanimeleaveoff.com/where-does-the-orient-anime-leave-off-in-the-manga/

JUDGMENT FORK on ep 12's END (46 vs 47): orient.fandom credits ep 12 with ch 47 pp. 1-5. I ruled 46 — the tail is 5 pages at A10's sliver threshold, pp. 2-4 are re-adapted in ep 13, the official synopsis stops before Shiryu Castle, and MU independently splits the cours at 46/47. If Sean prefers the strict 'pages, not numbers' reading (first-time pages = a real position), the value would be 47 + a `rearranged`/`partial` note and the continue would still be 47. Flagging because the two readings display different numbers.

FLAG #769 can be CLOSED as 'no edition split': one continuous space 1-156 / 22 vols across the WSM->Bessatsu move (Kodansha 初出 per volume; ja-WP 全156話; MangaDex lastChapter 156). MU's latest_chapter 121 is the ceiling of its scanlation RELEASE records (newest 2023-03-12 v14 c120), not an edition and not a count — the standing MU trap. AniList's 156 is our space.
